name: @seismic/src20-sdk
description: SDK for deploying SRC20 tokens via the Seismic factory contract

scripts.build: bun run build:cjs && bun run build:esm && bun run build:types
scripts.build:cjs: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist/_cjs --target browser --format cjs --external viem --external seismic-viem
scripts.build:esm: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist/_esm --target browser --format esm --external viem --external seismic-viem

author: Seismic Systems
